chunks.title: Plot and apartment suitability: an ellipse from Nilabadi to Visakhapatnam reaching up to 300 km to the coast · Bob the Builder
chunks.heading: What the data says
chunks.text: The ellipse is mostly hills, forest and sea. It covers 63,024 km², of which about 17,445 km² is sea. Of the 45,580 km² of land, only 15,470 km² (34%) passes every exclusion rule (slope, forest, water, roads, the CRZ proxy). Plot track: the best land lies in the coastal plain between Vizag, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam, and around Anakapalli. The top zone is on the edge of Vizianagaram town at Dharmapuri (88.5) , then the Rayagada town edge (85.1) and Anakapalli (84.2). Eleven of the 15 zones are in Andhra Pradesh plains mandals that are not on the published Scheduled mandal lists. The four Odisha zones are in fully Scheduled districts.

chunks.title: Plot and apartment suitability: an ellipse from Nilabadi to Visakhapatnam reaching up to 300 km to the coast · Bob the Builder
chunks.heading: What the data says
chunks.text: Close to Nilabadi: the earlier 50 km study still holds for anyone who wants to stay near the village. Rayagada and Parvathipuram lead there ( see the 50 km results ). Apartment track: central, well-served localities on higher ground score best: Akkayyapalem, Seethammadhara and Dwaraka Nagar , then Arilova and Marripalem on the BRTS. The NH16/IT corridor (Yendada, PM Palem, Madhurawada) is cheaper per sq ft and close to IT jobs, but sits farther from the centre and has drainage still being built. Coast: the whole coast is in the BMTPC Very High wind-damage zone (50 m/s). Land within 2 km of the sea gets the largest cyclone penalty, and land within 500 m is excluded as a CRZ proxy.

chunks.title: Plot and apartment suitability: an ellipse from Nilabadi to Visakhapatnam reaching up to 300 km to the coast · Bob the Builder
chunks.heading: Why an ellipse, and how it was drawn
chunks.text: The first version of this report looked at a 50 km circle around Nilabadi. This version reaches the coast. An ellipse with one focus at Nilabadi and the other in central Visakhapatnam covers both places and the corridor between them, and every point inside it has a combined distance to the two foci of at most 300 km. Along its axis it reaches a − c ≈ 82 km beyond each focus: north of Nilabadi into the Rayagada and Kalahandi uplands, and south of Vizag over the sea, which is masked out. Across the axis it is about 134 km wide on each side, which takes in the coast from Srikakulam to beyond Anakapalli.

chunks.title: Plot and apartment suitability: an ellipse from Nilabadi to Visakhapatnam reaching up to 300 km to the coast · Bob the Builder
chunks.heading: Why an ellipse, and how it was drawn
chunks.text: Focus 1 Nilabadi (Neelabadi) village, 18.9543 N, 83.2728 E ( OSM node 13121275838 ) Focus 2 Visakhapatnam city centre, taken as the APSRTC Dwaraka Bus Station (RTC Complex, Dwaraka Nagar), 17.7239 N, 83.3069 E ( OSM way 1389843166 , centroid) Distance between foci 136.24 km (geodesic, WGS84), so c = 68.12 km Semi-major axis a 150 km (major axis 300 km) Semi-minor axis b √(a² − c²) = 133.64 km Centre and orientation 18.339 N, 83.290 E; the major axis runs along the line between the foci, at an azimuth of about 178.5° (almost due south) Membership test a cell is inside if its geodesic distance to Nilabadi plus its distance to the Vizag point is 300 km or less Area 63,024 km² in total; 45,580 km² of land after removing the sea Sea mask The OSM coastline, drawn at 50 m as a barrier and flood-filled from the open sea Interactive map

chunks.heading: Caveats and checks
chunks.text: This is a desk study Satellite and map data cannot see title, land category, tribal-land rules, encroachment, local drainage or a builder's record. Use the results only to decide where to look. CRZ is a proxy. We excluded land within 500 m of the OSM coastline. The legal CRZ line is set from the High Tide Line in the approved Coastal Zone Management Plan (CRZ Notification 2019), and it also applies along tidal creeks and backwaters, which this proxy misses. Check the CZMP map for any coastal site. Cyclones and storm surge. The proxies are simple distance and height bands, not a hazard model. Cyclone Hudhud (2014) hit Visakhapatnam directly.

chunks.title: Plot and apartment suitability: an ellipse from Nilabadi to Visakhapatnam reaching up to 300 km to the coast · Bob the Builder
chunks.heading: Caveats and checks
chunks.text: Build to the wind zone (Vb = 50 m/s) and ask locally about past surge and flooding. Scheduled Areas. Koraput and Rayagada are fully Scheduled, and Odisha Regulation 2 of 1956 voids a transfer from a Scheduled Tribe member to a non-ST person. In Andhra Pradesh, Scheduled Areas are notified village by village inside the ITDA mandals, and the AP Land Transfer Regulation (1/70) applies there. Some villages outside the listed mandals are also Scheduled or under review, so confirm the status of the exact village with the revenue office. Two states, two systems.

chunks.text: Odisha (Bhulekh, Tahasil) and Andhra Pradesh ( Meebhoomi , MRO office) have different land records, registration, stamp duty and building rules. In the Vizag region, VMRDA and GVMC planning rules also apply. Elevation is a surface model. Copernicus GLO-30 includes buildings and trees, so city elevations read high and low-lying flags in dense areas are rough. Distances are measured on a 250 m grid (about ±125 m). OSM coverage is uneven. Hospitals, schools and job hubs are mapped better in Vizag than in the hills. Hub points were placed by hand at well-known sites and are approximate. Prices. Listing prices are asking prices, not sale values, and they change fast.

chunks.heading: The short answer
chunks.text: Homestay / Airbnb: the Vizag coast scores highest: Rushikonda–Sagar Nagar (90.1), Yarada coast (89.7), Bheemili coast (86.8). The hill zones (Araku, Chaparai, Borra–Ananthagiri) have the biggest crowds and the best scenery, but they are Scheduled Areas, where outsiders cannot buy land. There the realistic routes are a tribal-owned homestay or a lease or partnership that a lawyer has checked. Zostel-style hostel: Vizag station–Dwaraka Nagar (91.4), Vizag beach road (Siripuram–RK Beach) (87.2), MVP Colony–Lawsons Bay (82.4). Central Vizag has the rail and bus links, students and beaches, but Zostel already runs a Vizag hostel .

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: The short answer
chunks.text: We found no Zostel or goSTOPS listing in Araku, which ranks 4th (80.1). Vizianagaram (72.9) is a rail-junction outsider, close to the new airport. Multi-storey rental building: Seethammadhara (87.5), MVP Colony (82.7), Akkayyapalem (81.3), then Madhurawada (71.9) and Gajuwaka (71.5). Gajuwaka has the best published gross yield (about 3.3–4.0%), and Madhurawada is next to the IT hills. Gross yields in Vizag are low, about 2.5–4.0% before costs, so a rental block is a long-term hold, not a cash machine.

chunks.heading: Andhra Pradesh homestays and B&Bs
chunks.text: The AP Tourism Policy 2024–29 and its operational guidelines ( G.O.Ms.No.30 ) cover homestays and B&Bs. A homestay has 1–6 lettable rooms (2–12 beds) and the owner's family lives there. A B&B has the same cap but can be run by an agent or operator. Only units registered with the AP Tourism Authority ( APTA portal ) that meet the quality and safety standards qualify for incentives.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Tribal homestays in Alluri Sitharama Raju (ASR) district
chunks.text: ASR is one of 18 districts in a tribal homestay scheme, and the owner must be a tribesperson. A separate "Homestay" category does not need tribal ownership, and about 700 houses had been identified for it in Ananthagiri, Dumbriguda, Paderu, Araku and other mandals ( The Hindu, Aug 2025 ). By Nov 2025, 150 homestays had been approved. Homestays are recognised as MSME units, eligible for up to 35% subsidy, and graded silver or gold ( The Hindu, Nov 2025 ).

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Odisha homestays
chunks.text: Odisha's Go Homestay scheme gives financial incentives only for homestays in notified gram panchayats, to applicants aged 18 or over with no criminal record. It covers up to 4 rooms (8 beds) and needs clear ownership or a lease of at least 10 years. See also the Odisha Gazette notification .

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Fifth Schedule land
chunks.text: Araku, Paderu, Lambasingi, Borra–Ananthagiri and the whole of Koraput and Rayagada districts are Scheduled Areas ( Ministry of Panchayati Raj list ). In AP, Regulation 1/70 bars land transfers to non-tribals. A tribal joint action committee has said non-tribal construction there is illegal under 1/70 and listed about 400 such structures in Araku Valley and 650 in Paderu ( Deccan Chronicle ). In Odisha, on 29 Jan 2024 the Cabinet withdrew its decision to amend the rules so tribal land could be transferred to non-tribals, so the restrictions of Regulation 2 of 1956 still apply ( Kalinga TV , Sambad English ). We found no source that clears a lease to an outsider in a Scheduled village.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Fifth Schedule land
chunks.text: Treat any lease or partnership there as needing legal advice first. The tribal-owner homestay models above are the clearly sanctioned route.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ 2019)
chunks.text: In rural CRZ-III areas the No Development Zone is 200 m from the high tide line. It drops to 50 m only in densely populated CRZ-III A areas, and only after an approved coastal zone management plan. Inside the NDZ, tourism is limited to temporary facilities such as shacks, toilets and walkways, at least 10 m from the high tide line ( MCZMA , notification ). This hits beachfront plots at Rushikonda, Yarada, Bheemili and Kalingapatnam.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Cyclones
chunks.text: Hudhud crossed the coast at Visakhapatnam on 12 Oct 2014 with 180 km/h winds, killed 63 people in Andhra Pradesh and damaged 2,00,673 houses. Titli hit the Srikakulam coast in Oct 2018, killed 14 and damaged 50,120 houses ( APSDMA ; IMD reports on Hudhud and Titli ). Coastal buildings need wind-rated design and insurance.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: Building permission (VMRDA area)
chunks.text: Plans go through the online APDPMS system ( VMRDA planning ). Under the AP Building Rules 2017 ( G.O.Ms.No.119 ), a residential building of 18 m or more, stilt floor included, is a high-rise and needs prior fire-safety clearance. Buildings over 10 m also need soil and structural reports. Caveats

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: What could go wrong
chunks.text: Seasonality: the hill season peaks in winter. In 2019, Borra and Araku had about 88,095 visitors in April–May, against 1,10,622 a year earlier. The report blamed heat and humidity, and a tourism official said over 70% of Vizag's tourists came from West Bengal ( TOI, Jun 2019 ). A homestay that fills in December may sit near empty in May. Monsoon: heavy rain disrupts Vizag ( The Hindu, Aug 2025 ), and ghat roads, waterfalls and streams become risky from June to September. Oversupply around Araku: supply is growing fast: 700 houses were identified for homestays and 150 had been approved by Nov 2025. Illegal construction is disputed.

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: What could go wrong
chunks.text: No public figures on off-season occupancy exist, so we cannot measure whether there is already too much supply. Ask local operators before you build. OpenStreetMap gaps: OSM maps almost no hotels around Araku, Borra, Paderu or Lambasingi, although news reports describe them as full in season. That is why hotel density carries only 5 points. College, hospital and bus counts are OSM counts too, and incomplete. Missing figures: where no rent or yield was published (Akkayyapalem, Anakapalli, Kurmannapalem, Anandapuram, Tagarapuvalasa, Atchutapuram) we gave a neutral 0.5. Their rental ranks could move either way. Approximate points: zone centres are rounded to 3 decimals.

chunks.heading: What could go wrong
chunks.text: Vanjangi is placed approximately, near Paderu. Not covered: construction cost, finance, taxes, platform fees and actual occupancy rates. None of these were available as sourced figures for these areas. Method

chunks.title: Where to build a homestay, hostel or rental block: Visakhapatnam to Nilabadi
chunks.heading: How we scored
chunks.text: Zones were chosen by hand from known destinations, transport hubs and the localities in the land report, then checked to lie inside the land ellipse. Distances are geodesic, straight-line distances. Each factor runs from 0 to 1, falls linearly between a "good" and a "bad" distance, and is multiplied by its weight. Relief, elevation and coast distance come from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM and the grid in the land report. Points of interest come from the OpenStreetMap extracts for Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, 190 hotels, 193 colleges and 689 hospitals or clinics inside the ellipse.
